messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Canary validation error rate spiked for /inference/generate — 5xx rate 18% (threshold 5%). Affected: us-west-2-canary-3. Pager P1 triggered. See runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/canary-failures

oncall-amber: Taking pager — Amber (oncall). Looking at dashboards now.

sre-liam: Heatmap shows CPU and validation latency spike on the canary pods. Logs show repeated "validation timeout" from validator service.

eng-ryan: I rolled out r2023.3.7 to canary ~2m ago. I see the same. Attempting automated rollback first but automated policy didn't fire. Will do manual rollback.

eng-ryan: Plan: 1) Flip feature flag `use-new-validator` off 2) Drain traffic from us-west-2-canary-3 (graceful) 3) Revert deployment to r2023.3.6 4) Run quick smoke tests + monitor 15m then handoff.

pm-kate: Noting customer impact: support telemetry shows ~2% overall requests affected, higher in batch image->text jobs. Notifying support.

ops-nina: Kicking off drain of canary nodes (job id: drain-213999). Drain started, syncing connections — ETA ~90s.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by eng-ryan: revert r2023.3.7 -> r2023.3.6. Rollback job rb-98765.

eng-ryan: Reverted. `kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-service -n prod` shows all pods at r2023.3.6 and Ready=3/3.

eng-ryan: Quick smoke: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://inference.prod/api/v1/generate` -> 200. Running a few sample prompts against the old validator, responses look normal.

oncall-amber: Metrics updating: canary 5xx down to 1.2% in the last minute, overall 5xx back to baseline. Keeping eyes on latency for 15m.

support-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2023-451 and linked to customer-facing status.

pm-kate: I'll draft a short customer blurb. @support-bot please prep template for affected accounts. :thumbsup:

eng-ryan: Root cause note: automated rollback didn't trigger because the alert used metric name `http5xx` while the autoscaler/rollback service watches `response_5xx`. I'll push a fix to align metrics/alerting naming in infra-metrics.

sre-liam: From the runbook: collect `/var/log/validator.log`, traceroots under /traces/canary-213999, and stack dumps if any. Assigning postmortem to eng-ryan to capture rollout gating gaps and validator regression tests.

eng-ryan: Assigning to myself for postmortem. Will include test coverage for validator fallback and add a canary smoke that exercises the validator timeout edge.

oncall-amber: Handoff: I'll stay on watch for 35m total since pager start. If nothing resurfaces, I hand back oncall.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Pager closed by oncall-amber. Duration ~35m. Severity: P1 -> Resolved.

eng-ryan: Follow-up actions: 1) fix metric naming + deploy alert 2) add pre-rollout small test hitting validator timeout path 3) run a canary flood test in staging. Will post postmortem link when ready.

pm-kate: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate customer comms after postmortem review.

oncall-amber: Back to regular oncall. If anything comes up ping me directly.
